guidelines.detail: same as LRN-018 (The description states that the agency informs the banking process and then continues with further work. The reference includes a sender-side task, while the generated model instead has a receiving event; these records support modeling the explicitly stated notification from the sender’s perspective. This is essentially the same guidance as LRN-018.)

refines COL-01 (The description establishes a user-facing interface through which a process is started and results or delay information are returned. The collaboration records show the corresponding interface pool and message flows are absent from the generated model. This specifies how to apply the general participant-pool guidance in COL-01 to a software interface.)
kept for this example only, tied to it by: communicates

same as LRN-045 (The description says clerks use an interface to receive scoring, which starts a process in the banking system; the records show the interface pool and its message flow are absent while the system is represented as a lane. This supports modeling the interface separately. The guideline matches learned guideline LRN-045; documented COL-01 provides the broader rule to represent distinct participants a)

refines ACT-05 (The description specifies both that the process receives a delay notice and that it later displays a message to a user. The generated model includes a catching event but lacks the separate user-facing task, while the reference task has no counterpart in the generated model. This refines ACT-05 by applying its distinction between message events and tasks to the case where both receipt and subsequen)

refines FID-03 (The description distinguishes an outgoing request from information sent back after a result is determined (S3, S9), while the label pair for the request uses wording that describes the returned information (P5). This makes faithful labels for distinct communication activities the best-supported guideline. It refines FID-03 by specifying how to keep communication labels faithful.)

same as LRN-045 (The description establishes a user-facing interface through which the process is initiated and results or delay information are communicated. The collaboration records show the corresponding pool and message flows have no counterparts in the generated model. This is essentially the same guideline as LRN-045.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends information to another participant: Model and label the activity from the sender’s perspective as sending the information, rather than as the recipient receiving it.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly states that one participant notifies another participant of a change while continuing its own process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes related activities or events by what is sent or received, or by different outcomes

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a person uses a software interface to start a process in another system and receives the process outcome through that interface: Model the interface as a separate participant pool and represent the request and returned information with message flows between it and the system process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a person uses a software interface to start a process in another system and receives the process outcome through that interface

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says one participant communicates a delay to another participant before continuing its own work: Model the notification as a message send task in the sender’s process, and model receipt separately as a message catch event in the recipient’s process when receipt is stated.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says one participant communicates a delay to another participant before continuing its own work

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity with explicit alternatives or qualifiers that distinguish its scope: Label the corresponding BPMN element concisely while preserving those stated distinctions; do not generalize them away.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes communication actions by the information being exchanged and whether it is sent or received

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes an incoming notice about a delay or status change from a subsequent communication of that information to a user.: Model receipt of the incoming notice as a catching message event, and model the user-facing communication as a separate task.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes an incoming notice about a delay or status change from a subsequent communication of that information to a user.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes communication activities by the information conveyed or by their direction: label each communication activity to reflect its own message content and whether the participant sends or receives it, rather than using a label for a different exchange
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes communication activities by the information conveyed or by their direction
